sections.Profile:
Mexico 86, released by Zaccaria in July 1986, is a solid-state pinball machine themed around soccer, coinciding with the FIFA World Cup held in Mexico that year. The game features four flippers, including two on an upper left mini-playfield, three pop bumpers, and two ramps.

- Manufacturer: Zaccaria
- Years made: 1986
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Soccer, World Cup, Sports, Solid State, 1980s
